name: Oberoi Esquire
address: Oberoi Garden City, off Western Express Highway, Goregaon East, Mumbai 400063
description: Three high-rise residential towers (A, B and C) with 882 apartments in Oberoi Realty's Oberoi Garden City township in Goregaon East. Homes are 3 BHK and 4 BHK in Superior, Supreme and Royale configurations. Oberoi was ready to hand over possession in early 2018.
notes: MahaRERA P51800005229 (registered 11 Aug 2017, completion date 30 Jun 2018; 882 units: Tower A 296, B 294, C 292). Launch date conflicts: Sep 2010 (Aurum PropTech), Oct 2010 (Housing.com), Feb 2011 (Mumbai Property Exchange, quoting the developer). possession_actual is approximate (month only), taken from a 16 Mar 2018 report that Oberoi was ready to hand over possession; Square Yards says 'ready to move since Dec 2017'. Floor count conflicts: Mumbai Property Exchange cites MahaRERA as up to 70 (A 70, B 70, C 69, probably including podium/parking levels), while its developer description says 51 storeys, so floors_max is omitted. Land area is also unclear: RERA shows 3,306.78 (units unspecified) and Aurum gives 0.82 acres, so it is omitted. Booking status varies by snapshot: 616 sold (PropScience), 609 of 882 (Square Yards, Apr 2026). Brokerage and Business Standard coverage (2015, 2017) credited Esquire with driving Oberoi's sales volumes and margins. No launch-era per-sq-ft price was found. Do not confuse this project with the older Oberoi Exquisite next door (2009 launch at Rs 9,500/sq ft).

unit_types.notes: MahaRERA carpet areas are 1,367-1,496 sq ft. Prices are Square Yards asking prices (Sep 2026). A Mumbai Property Exchange price list dated 9 Jul 2026 shows Rs 5.3-6.6 Cr for 3 BHK, which conflicts with this.

price_points.note: Rate shown on a project page last updated June 2018; it may be a developer or listing asking rate.

price_points.source_name: Sharekhan research (Oberoi Realty inventory table, 3 Sep 2021)
price_points.note: Computed: unsold Esquire inventory of 197,919 sq ft valued at Rs 452 crore as of Q1 FY22, with the project 100% complete (source: company / Sharekhan). The table doesn't state the area basis; Oberoi reports on RERA carpet since FY18, so this may be carpet. It is lower than the 2018 HousingMan figure, and the gap is unexplained.
Quarterly average asking price; basis inferred as carpet because the unit prices divided by carpet area match.
Average asking price for the Sep 2026 quarter; the Goregaon East average was Rs 32,800.
Average registered rate from 6 sale registrations, Nov 2025-Oct 2026 (gross value Rs 47 Cr).

news.title: Oberoi Realty retains good quarter, strong launch momentum

news.title: Strong earnings growth ahead for Oberoi Realty
